notes.title: January Known Issue
notes.notes:
Hello Soulkeepers!!

We'd like to address a known issue regarding the New Year's Buff on the German and French. 
Although the buff display is currently not visible, we want to assure you that the buff is active and working as intended.

**New Year's Buff Details:**
1. EXP gain increased by 200%
2. Gold gain increased by 100%
3. Item drop increased by 100%
4. Jewel Enhancement Success Rate increased by 300%

Rest assured that our development team is actively working to resolve the display matter on the 
German and French. In the meantime, feel free to enjoy the boosted benefits of the New Year's 
Buff as you embark on your adventures!

We appreciate your understanding and wish you continued joy in the new year!

notes.title: Surprise EOC Boost Campaign!
notes.notes:
Happy New Year!

Hello Soulkeepers!

We are announcing perfect event for the end of and new year; EOC boost! [b]Just for 3 days.[/b]

Do not miss this opportunity to earn more EOC than usual

Period: 30.12.2023 00:00 - 01.01.2024 23:59 (CET)

Details: During the event period, you will receive additional bonuses depending on the 

amount of EOC you charged!

[b]*the bonus will be delivered by 31.01.2024[/b]

[b]*Maximum bonus EOC caps out at 4,095[/b]

30 USD+ : 3% bonus EOC

50 USD+ : 5% bonus EOC

100 USD+ : 8% bonus EOC

[b]200 USD+ : 10% bonus EOC + 10 Fantastic Stabilization Catalyst + 10 Guru's Safeguard

300 USD+ : 15% bonus EOC + 1 Superb Stabilization Catalyst[/b]

We thank you for your support in 2023, and continued support in 2024.

Happy New Year!

In addition, we have prepared a variety of events to commemorate the opening of Steam, so please check the details below.
